{{Top|leg}}
An '''electronic mine''' was a form of [[Land mine/Legends|land mine]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to defend the [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lotide]]. They were located in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] surrounding the installation, but the local wildlife were known to detonate on average five mines per day. Instead of constantly replacing the mines, base personnel simply turned the minefield off with plans to reactivate the field if the situation was warranted.
